A [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] '''monk''' who operated out of an [[Equilibrates|Equilibrate]] chapel at a [[Wayfarer's Temple]] in [[Falleen Throne]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the planet [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]], also acted as an agent of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. When the [[holostar]] and Rebel agent [[Javul Charn]] visited Falleen as part of a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] tour, the monk provided her with a [[data wafer]] containing updated orders and codes to access a container she was to pick for the Alliance while performing on [[Bannistar Station]].
